title: Approved plastic materials.
officialText:
Plastic materials which burn at a rate no faster than 2.5 inches per minute (64 mm/s)
when tested in accordance with ASTM D 635 shall be deemed approved plastics and can be used as the display surface material
and for the letters, decorations and facings on signs, subject to the area limitations of Sections H107.1.2 through H107.1.3.
Exception: Flexible vinyl signs shall comply with the requirements of Section H114.
